157ab2cc-1fc7-4b29-8955-72d94a140982.altTitle: They are Still Being Shaken This Morning
157ab2cc-1fc7-4b29-8955-72d94a140982.description:
Every morning at 6:58, commuters hurry onto the train at Sakuranomiya Station. For the past few months, a tentative romance has been brewing between two students from different schools. The young man is easily flustered, always stealing a glance at the young woman, but never making a move—much to the disappointment of the other passengers, who have been cheering them on in secret. Will this budding love story ever blossom?

fbaa78f2-fec9-418e-aba8-288c35929c9e.title: Akinai Ningyo to Soku no Hatsukoi
fbaa78f2-fec9-418e-aba8-288c35929c9e.altTitle: The Trading Mermaid and Sora's First Love
fbaa78f2-fec9-418e-aba8-288c35929c9e.description:
Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option…

One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden.
He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…?!

A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”!

0e017a08-835a-4cbe-ba63-576d5010a5a0.altTitle: くま　クマ　熊　ベアー(コミック)
0e017a08-835a-4cbe-ba63-576d5010a5a0.description: Yuna, a 15-year-old girl, started playing the world's first VRMMO. She has earned billions of yen in stocks and confines herself in her house playing the game without going to school. Today, a major update has arrived and she obtained a non-transferable rare bear outfit. But the equipment is so embarrassing that she can't wear it even in the game. Furthermore, when she answers the survey regarding the new update and relaunches the game, she appears in an unknown forest in the bear outfit. Where is this? Email from God? A different world? If she wears the bear outfit she's a cheat, if she takes it off she's a normal girl.

3aa7c81d-fd51-4885-a36d-e80e3ae7d229.title: Tetsu Sabi to 1000 Carat
3aa7c81d-fd51-4885-a36d-e80e3ae7d229.description: This is a world where "Jewel" people are born with jewels in their eyes and special abilities.They live in a vast mansion called "The Jewelry Box," and their duty is to grant people's wishes. The new arrival at the Jewelry Box is Yuni, a girl with iron ore in her eyes, who is far from a beautiful jewel. Although she started her life as a "Jewel," she was not able to help people as much as she would like. Then she meets Aleclaire, a "Jewel" who is rumored to be a "jewel killer," they seem to be pursuing the unknown dark side of the jewelry box. In order to get closer to the truth, Yuni helps Aleclaire and meets various other "jewels". Little does she know that she herself will eventually become the one to change the world. Follow your wishes and uncover the truth of the beautiful jewelry box world.

299d467a-5228-438e-ab32-9b6552c0ddbe.title: Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle
299d467a-5228-438e-ab32-9b6552c0ddbe.altTitle: The Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle
299d467a-5228-438e-ab32-9b6552c0ddbe.description:
On the night the kingdom fell and the entire royal family was being executed, Clarisse, who naturally thought she would also die, heard something unexpected. 

“We cannot execute anyone who has not reached the age of eighteen. Instead, I will kill you the day you turn eighteen.” 

And so, Clarisse is given ten years to live. 
Clarisse then heads North as a “prisoner.” 
And she asks the Grand Duke for only one thing… 

“Um, is it okay if I take this friend with me? It’s my only friend.” 

But what Clarisse holds out is a rock? 

It’s a new life in the North! 
But this life as a “prisoner” keeps on getting better…?

f51384d7-f4f2-4cbf-9a26-f7f7f6e200f2.title: Killer Sitter
f51384d7-f4f2-4cbf-9a26-f7f7f6e200f2.description:
A legendary mercenary Log Killer, once feared as a killing machine on the battlefield, has arrived in Japan. He has taken on a new name: Ryusei Nogawa. 

His mission: to "raise a baby." 

But Nogawa, who has never known a peaceful, quiet life, is struggling mightily with parenting for the first time!? To ensure the healthy growth of the mischievous Hoshina-chan, he must "legally" eliminate any dangers that come his way!

a4e50325-1fa4-4906-a0a6-4ea4ee6c399f.title: Shinigami Shoujo wa Kage kara Oshi o Nagametai: Akuyaku ni TS Tensei Shita kedo, Kossori Gensaku Chara o Kansatsu Shi ni Ikimasu!
a4e50325-1fa4-4906-a0a6-4ea4ee6c399f.altTitle: A Grim Reaper Girl Wants to Admire Her Faves from the Shadows: Reincarnated as a Female Villain, I will Spy on the Main Characters!
a4e50325-1fa4-4906-a0a6-4ea4ee6c399f.description:
After dying alone in a hospital room in modern-day Japan, a man was reincarnated as Bloom, a girl from the manga "Souls Light Nobly," known for its depressing plot twists.

By wielding the power of the Grim Reaper, Bloom would eventually become captivated by death and choose to die voluntarily and yet...

“There’s no way I, who’ve already died once, could be captivated by death.”

With her experience of death allowing her to wield the powers of the Grim Reaper without risk, Bloom trembled with joy.

“With this power... I can admire my favorite OTP to my heart’s content!”

Unfazed by the Grim Reaper’s confusion—Eh, what's an OTP…?—Bloom’s cheat-powered days of observing her favorite characters begin!
